newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed mostly steady at 43.7460/7500 to the dollar in an active interbank session on Monday, against the previous 43.7480/7500, dealers said.
The local currency was quoted at 43.7400/7500 per dollar in early trade but most deals were done at 43.7480.

Dealers said the U.S. currency failed to make any significant gains despite demands from importers due to selling by some foreign banks. The interbank call money rates closed at 7.0 to 10 percent, down from the previous 8.0-11 percent.
